Appeal,    and    such    grants    and
dispositions  of  lands  and  other

required or empowered to do, and to
usethe  Public  Seal for  sealing all
things  whatsoever  that  shall  pass

to declare war and peace; and
to  do  all  such  acts  and  things,  not
inconsistent with the provisions of
the Constitution  or written law,  as

usage the President is authorized or
required to do.”.
